## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is based on `main`, or on the applicable `release/X.Y` branch for an approved backport.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer matching the author identity.

- [ ] Security vulnerabilities are being handled through a private advisory rather than disclosed here.
